android.desc:
Known from print and TV - see smhaggle.com/presse.

Fast, efficient and at the lowest price and with lots of advantages - that's ideally how shopping should be. We have now invented something that didn't exist before and call it "smhaggle" - your clever app that helps you plan your shopping in the supermarket, create and manage shopping lists, find the best offer prices without browsing through brochures, and retailers Compare product prices, get great cashback and save money.

And it’s that easy:

First of all: Register for free in the smhaggle app with your email address and password. And then it starts:

Determine where you want to shop: Use the map to determine your location and shopping radius. The smhaggle app shows you all the supermarkets and discounters available here.

Get inspired: The homepage shows you current special offers from your supermarkets and discounters. Click through individual product categories or specifically through offers from individual retailers. Browse through products popular with other users or view sustainable products.

Search and find products: The product search gives you access to many thousands of products from supermarkets and discounters, with current prices within your specified shopping radius. Use the text search or the EAN scanner to find the product.

Get detailed information: By clicking on the product you will receive further information about current prices and price trends, alternative products, user reviews and product seals such as organic or vegan.

Create your favorites list: Save your favorite products as favorites to keep an eye on price changes and current special offers at any time. If you wish, you will receive a message when your favorites are on sale.

Get attractive cashbacks: Redeem promotions in the smhaggle app by taking a photo of the receipt as proof of purchase. The cashback will then be credited to your user account. You can easily transfer the balance in your user account to your bank account.

Create your shopping list: Add products to your shopping list, 
View the cheapest offers for your products and shop with your smhaggle APP.

Save cleverly with every purchase: Let the smhaggle app calculate the lowest costs for your planned purchase using the shopping list. Then follow the dealer selection displayed in the app, adjust the number of dealers and you can go shopping at the cheapest price. This is how you really save money.
